description: A captured aircraft datalink message (ACARS, VDL2, or HFDL). These are low-volume, high-value records that represent individual communications between aircraft and ground stations.

protocol.description: Datalink protocol the message was received on.

icaoHex.description: ICAO 24-bit aircraft address in hexadecimal, if identifiable.

callsign.description: Flight callsign as identified in the message.

registration.description: Aircraft registration, if identifiable from the message.

frequencyMhz.description: Frequency the message was received on, in MHz (e.g. '131.550').

groundStation.description: Ground station involved in the communication, if identifiable.

label.description: ACARS message label (two-character code indicating message type).

sublabel.description: ACARS sublabel for further message classification.

position.description: Aircraft position at the time of the message, if included.

receiverDid.description: DID of the receiver that captured this message.

capturedAt.description: When the message was received by the station.

groundStationInfo.description: Identification of the ground station involved in the datalink communication.

id.description: Ground station identifier (e.g. HFDL station ID, VDL2 ground station address).

location.description: Geographic position of the ground station.
